name: RAAG
description: RAAG – The Youth Club of RVCE is a vibrant student-led community that brings campus life alive through exciting events like Matrubhasha Diwas, Treasure Hunt, Night Cricket, cultural celebrations, and social initiatives. Built by the youth, for the youth, RAAG fosters leadership, creativity, teamwork, and unforgettable experiences while creating a fun, inclusive, and energetic environment for every student.

events.name: ICE BREAKER GAMES- LAUGH. CONNECT. REPEAT.
events.detail: KICK THINGS OFF WITH LAUGHTER AND CHAOS! FUN, QUIRKY GAMES TO HELP YOU VIBE WITH YOUR BATCHMATES AND MAKE INSTANT CONNECTIONS-NO AWKWARD INTROS, JUST PURE FUN.
